news.title: LGT Business Connextions Limited Appoints Namrata Kalanouria as Independent Director, Effective from 10 March 2026
news.body: LGT Business Connextions Limited reported that shareholders, by means of resolution passed through Postal Ballot, approved the appointment of Mrs. Namrata Kalanouria (DIN: 11594142) as Independent Director of the Company. Mrs. Namrata Kalanouria has been appointed as Independent Director for the first term of five consecutive years commencing from March 10, 2026 to March 9, 2031. Mrs. Namrata holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree along with professional degree from Institute of Company Secretaries of India. She is a qualified professional with experience with over ten years of post-qualification experience in corporate laws, regulatory compliance, and corporate governance.
